documents_required.quote:
Copies of federal tax forms (IRS1040, etc.) for the past year
q For bank accounts, copies of all pages of the most recent statement
q For investment accounts, copies of all pages of the most recent statement
q For wages, copies of paystubs (for the past 30 days)
q For self-employment income, copies of Schedule C or profit / loss statements for the past month
q For other types of income,copies of proofs of income, such as: 
❍Social Security 1099 form
❍Pension or other retirement income statement
❍Alimony, child / spousal support agreement
❍Rental or royalty income agreement
❍Veterans / disability award letter
❍Unemployment Compensation or Workers’ Compensation award letter
q For patients with no income: Letter of support signed by person who provides support
q To show Medical Assistance denial: Copies of form PA-162 for all services denied (for PA residents only)
